SELECT fish_date_season AS season, (fish_date_doy/10)*10 AS doy_bin, cls,
       SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS ang, COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 170 AND 330
  AND cls IN ('overnight','day_1_5','three_quarter')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 2,3

SELECT date_season AS season, (date_doy/10)*10 AS doy_bin,
       ROUND(AVG(cuti),3) AS avg_cuti, ROUND(AVG(beuti),3) AS avg_beuti, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM upwelling
WHERE date_season = 2 AND date_doy BETWEEN 90 AND 182
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 2

SELECT fish_date_season AS season, (fish_date_doy/10)*10 AS doy_bin, cls,
       SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS ang, COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 250 AND 330
  AND cls IN ('overnight','day_1_5','three_quarter')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 2,3

SELECT fish_date_season AS season, (fish_date_doy/10)*10 AS doy_bin, cls,
       SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS ang, COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season IN (1,2) AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 260 AND 320
  AND cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','hd_twilight')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 1,2,3
